"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1870 by Warner & Higgins in the Clerks Office of the District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania." Includes business directories, Paris city references, population statistics (1865), views of commercial properties. Insets: City of Paris -- Elbridge -- New Athens -- Logan -- Cherry Point -- Kansas -- Conlogue -- Grandview -- West Sanford -- Kentucky -- Vermillion -- Dudley. LC copy mounted on linen.
